name: Bentley Edison
climate: Central New Jersey (Middlesex County, US Route 1 corridor): cold winters with snow, ice and sub-freezing mornings that strain batteries and thicken oil; heavy road salt on Route 1, the New Jersey Turnpike and local roads from November through March (undercarriage, brake-line and rocker-panel corrosion); freeze-thaw potholes from February through April (tires, wheels, alignment); hot, humid summers with stop-and-go Route 1 and Turnpike traffic (cooling and A/C load).
brandNaming: Write 'Bentley' and model names in full (Bentayga, Bentayga EWB, Continental GT, Continental GTC, Flying Spur)
'Genuine Bentley Parts', 'Bentley Service Advisor' and 'Bentley-trained' are the dealer's own offer wording; use them only in that sense and make no other expertise claims

Do not mention Maserati unless the article is about it (sister store Maserati of Central New Jersey is at 816 US Route 1, Edison); the same applies to Ferrari (Ferrari of Central New Jersey, also at 816 Route 1)
